verdict.rationale: Convex ships a documented official MCP server exposing tools for AI agents to interact with a Convex deployment, with safety guardrails (no prod access by default), and hands-on probes confirm the server responds to a JSON-RPC initialize handshake via `npx convex mcp start`. This is a service/platform (not itself an agent), so the MCP-server axis applies and is met with concrete first-party plus hands-on evidence. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Convex) reports of using the MCP server in production workflows.
